task_description: Build a FastAPI application with SQLite that accepts syllabus and calendar data, stores it in a database, provides an allocation engine to break lesson counts from syllabus across sub-topics into teaching weeks, and generates schemes of work and lesson plans from the stored data models. Includes a textbook placeholder for future integration.

verification.summary: All 40 tests pass (32 original + 8 new review-fix tests). Review fixes applied: (1) allocation idempotency via delete-before-insert, (2) lesson-plan date derivation uses periods_per_day for multi-period schedules, (3) teaching methods and references derived from competences/textbook data, (4) FK validation on textbook POST rejects invalid sub_topic_id, (5) SQLite PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON enforced on all connections.
